faqs.q: Where can I find support after a natural disaster?
faqs.a: Recovery centres provide support and resources following a natural disaster.

faqs.q: What kind of help is available at recovery centres?
faqs.a: Recovery centres offer various services, including support for immediate needs and connecting people with further assistance.

faqs.q: How do I find a recovery centre?
faqs.a: The page provides information on locating and accessing recovery centres in your area.
